proposed_capability: Host-owned camera-safe lot traversal that forbids parking the mouse in the screen-edge pan band, prefers PrintWindow capture + recursive lot-model observe over edge-scroll scanning, and requires every camera step to end at a SAFE_CURSOR_REST interior point.
player_save_control_impact: No saves, game files, or unattended daemon. Evaluate-only plans are pure. Optional --execute requires existing screen_admit session + PID and parks the cursor outside the edge band after each step. Does not authorize Resume or user-save mutation.
expected_outcome: Agents gather lot data through host CAMERA_SAFE_TRAVERSE / CAPTURE_ONLY steps that always terminate at SAFE_CURSOR_REST; EDGE_MOUSE_PARK and continuous edge-hold are classified BAD_BEHAVIOR and fail closed.
negative_tests: Cursor in edge band yields CAMERA_SAFE_REST before needs clicks
Plan without terminal SAFE_REST is rejected
EDGE_MOUSE_PARK / CONTINUOUS_EDGE_HOLD never selected as good practice
Capture-first preferred over edge scroll when scan requested
No vision-invented scene claims from offline planner
rollback_path: Revert isolated source commits; no game files or saves touched.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact Sims edge-band pixel width per resolution/DPI on disposable lab hosts
Whether WASD/arrow camera chords are enabled in the current operator camera mode
P08 live proof that parked rest stops continuous pan on a real window
